title: Oven-Roasted Spanish Potatoes Patatas Bravas
description: A traditional Spanish tapas dish featuring crispy roasted potatoes and a spicy tomato sauce. Serve with crusty bread for a satisfying snack or side dish.

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.notes: Choose high-starch potatoes like Russet or Idaho.

instructions: Peel and cut the potatoes into 1-inch wedges.
Place the potato wedges in a bowl and drizzle with olive oil, tossing to coat.
Sprinkle the potatoes with garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, tossing to combine.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the potatoes in a single layer.
Roast the potatoes in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until crispy on the outside and tender on the inside.
Meanwhile, warm the tomato sauce in a saucepan over low heat.

To assemble the Patatas Bravas, place a portion of the roasted potatoes on a plate or in a bowl, followed by a spoonful of the warmed tomato sauce and a sprinkle of Manchego cheese and sliced red onion if using.
Serve immediately with crusty bread on the side.
